title: Metrics gaps
description: What differs between the metrics the Redpanda source registers and the metrics a cluster exported, written by doc-tools generate metrics-docs as metrics-gaps.json. The automated pull request prints it, and the Metrics gaps check fails while count is above 0.

count.description: How many gaps need a person: every list below except covered_by_override, redundant_overrides and retired_overrides.

not_scraped.description: In source, not exported by the cluster, with no written reason and no override. Documented from source, without labels.

not_in_source.description: Exported by the cluster and not in the source inventory. The source scan missed a registration.

unresolved.description: Metric registrations the source scan could not read. A metric may be missing from the reference.

stale_requirements.description: Ids in the requirements file that match no metric in this release.

stale_overrides.description: Names in the overrides file that are not metrics in this release.

override_disagrees.description: Overrides that name a label the cluster does not export for a metric it does export.

covered_by_override.description: Not exported by the cluster, and completed by an override. Not counted.

redundant_overrides.description: Parts of the overrides file that no longer change anything. Listed when the run did not retire them. Not counted.

retired_overrides.description: Parts of the overrides file this run deleted. Not counted.

defined_in.description: Source file that registers the metric.

field.description: The field, or labels[<label>], or empty for the whole override.
